tasks.label: javac: all solutions
tasks.command: $jh='C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21.0.3.9-hotspot'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin | Out-Null; $files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path 'algorithms\solutions' -Filter '*.java' -ErrorAction Stop); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'No java files'; exit 1 }; & "$jh\bin\javac.exe" -g -encoding UTF-8 -d bin @($files.FullName); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host ('OK: compiled ' + $files.Count + ' files to bin/')
